question:
Choose the most appropriate antonym of the underlined word.

Why is there __**fascination**__, dissection, and constant conversation whenever Beyoncé or any female celebrity changes her hair?
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"fascination"** means a strong attraction or interest in something. (मोह)

 
 
• **Example:** The **fascination** with space exploration has only grown over the years.
 
 
 
• **"Repulsion"** refers to a strong feeling of dislike or disgust. (घृणा)
 
 
• **Example:** She felt a sense of** repulsion **when she saw the spoiled food.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'fascination'** is **'repulsion'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Allure** (आकर्षण): The quality of being powerfully and mysteriously attractive or fascinating.

 
 
• **Example:** The allure of the ancient ruins drew many tourists to the site.
 
 
 
• **Spell** (जादू): A form of words used as a magical charm or incantation.
 
 
• **Example:** The magician cast a spell to make the rabbit disappear.
 
 
 
• **Appeal** (अपील): The quality of being attractive or interesting.
 
 
• **Example:** The new product has great appeal to younger consumers.
